description: This file defines a UI Button component using LightningJS's Blits component framework. It includes properties for label,variant, size, and visual effects, as well as computed styles and interaction handlers.

classes.name: UIButton
classes.description: A customizable button component with different visual variants and interactive states.

methods.name: bgColor
methods.description: Computes the background color based on the button's variant.

methods.name: txtColor
methods.description: Determines the text color based on the button's variant.

methods.name: effects
methods.description: Calculates the visual effects applied to the button, varying by variant.

methods.name: pointerover
methods.description: Sets hover transparency on pointer over.

methods.name: pointerout
methods.description: Resets hover transparency on pointer out.
